mtl.title: Master Equation for Total Coherence
mtl.equation: chi = integral(G * M * E * S * T * K * R * Q * F * C) dV dt
mtl.wordEquation: coherence = the accumulated product of grace, meaning, entropy, self, time, knowledge, relation, quantum, faith, and Christ across reality
mtl.structuralInsight: The terms are multiplied, not added. If any required factor goes to zero, the whole product collapses.
mtl.plain: Everything essential has to be present together. You cannot replace a missing foundation by increasing a different one.
mtl.influence: The equation strengthens when required factors remain present together; it collapses when one required factor disappears.

mtl.title: Justice and Mercy Closed-System Constraint
mtl.equation: J = T_A/D, M = 1 - T_B/D, T_A = T_B => J = 1 - M
mtl.wordEquation: justice = offender payment divided by damage, mercy = one minus victim burden divided by damage, closed balance makes justice equal one minus mercy
mtl.structuralInsight: The equality T_A = T_B is the closed-system boundary. Under that boundary, justice and mercy move in opposite directions.
mtl.plain: If the same internal payment must satisfy both sides, making justice complete makes mercy incomplete, and making mercy complete makes justice incomplete.
mtl.influence: The constraint fails only if the system boundary changes or the definition of justice, mercy, damage, or transfer changes.

reader_layers.highschool:
The Idea, Simply

The master equation says that reality does not hold together because of one ingredient alone. It holds together when the required parts stay connected at the same time.

The master equation treats coherence as a product of required factors rather than a sum of optional contributions.

That means one missing foundation cannot be replaced by simply adding more of another one.

In a closed system, full justice and full mercy cannot both be satisfied after real damage without an external voluntary cost-bearer.
reader_layers.college:
The Argument

The master equation models total coherence as an accumulated product over required domains. Its structural claim is multiplicative: the factors are not interchangeable decorations.

The master equation treats coherence as a product of required factors rather than a sum of optional contributions.

The same logic appears in the trilemma atom. In a closed exchange after damage, justice and mercy cannot both be maximized if the only available transfers remain inside the damaged system.

In a closed system, full justice and full mercy cannot both be satisfied after real damage without an external voluntary cost-bearer.
reader_layers.phd:
The Formal Statement

Let chi denote total coherence under the proposed cross-domain model. The equation places its required terms in product relation under integration across the relevant domain. The immediate mathematical consequence is zero-factor collapse.

The master equation treats coherence as a product of required factors rather than a sum of optional contributions.

For the trilemma atom, assume D > 0, J = T_A/D, M = 1 - T_B/D, and strong budget balance T_A = T_B. Then J = 1 - M, so J = 1 and M = 1 cannot be jointly satisfied within the closed system. A voluntary external transfer changes the boundary condition.

In a closed system, full justice and full mercy cannot both be satisfied after real damage without an external voluntary cost-bearer.
